scope: Source-declared top-level built-in slash names, documented subcommands, Unicode icon symbolic maps, static ui setting metadata; dynamic runtime/plugin settings and command availability intentionally not inferred.

settings_controls.label: Auto Resume
settings_controls.description: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory

settings_controls.label: Enable Git Integration
settings_controls.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

settings_controls.label: Dark Theme
settings_controls.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

settings_controls.label: Light Theme
settings_controls.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

settings_controls.label: Symbol Preset
settings_controls.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

settings_controls.label: Color-Blind Mode
settings_controls.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

settings_controls.label: Composer Shape
settings_controls.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

settings_controls.label: Generation Rate
settings_controls.description: Show a live generation tok/s readout: on the working row next to the session title, or in the native composer bar right after the thinking level, where the last reading stays between turns. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.

settings_controls.label: Status Line Preset
settings_controls.description: Pre-built status line configurations

settings_controls.label: Status Line Separator
settings_controls.description: Style of separators between segments

settings_controls.label: Context-Reactive Line
settings_controls.description: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

settings_controls.label: Session Accent
settings_controls.description: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

settings_controls.label: Transparent Status Line
settings_controls.description: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

settings_controls.label: Compact Thinking Level
settings_controls.description: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix; in Tern's composer, as the model chip's icon instead of a separate chip (click the icon to cycle it).

settings_controls.label: Show Hook Status
settings_controls.description: Display hook status messages below the status line

settings_controls.label: Show Inline Images
settings_controls.description: Render images inline in the terminal

settings_controls.label: Auto-Resize Images
settings_controls.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

settings_controls.label: Block Images
settings_controls.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

settings_controls.label: Resize Scrollback
settings_controls.description: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

settings_controls.label: Native Terminal Progress
settings_controls.description: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running (always on in Tern)

settings_controls.label: Program Status (OSC 7501)
settings_controls.description: Report whether the agent is working, waiting on you, done, or failed over OSC 7501, for terminal tab indicators and agent inboxes

settings_controls.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
settings_controls.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

settings_controls.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
settings_controls.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

settings_controls.label: Render SVG Figures
settings_controls.description: Invite the agent to draw diagrams and charts as SVG, rendered inline as images on terminals that show graphics

settings_controls.label: Auto-Graph Tables
settings_controls.description: Draw a chart under numeric tables in the agent's answers, in your theme's colors, on terminals that show graphics

settings_controls.label: Agent Reactions
settings_controls.description: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble

settings_controls.label: Terminal Title Run State
settings_controls.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

settings_controls.label: Terminal Title Spinner
settings_controls.description: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line

settings_controls.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
settings_controls.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

settings_controls.label: Tight Layout
settings_controls.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

settings_controls.label: Shimmer
settings_controls.description: Animation style for working/loading messages

settings_controls.label: Pinned Agents
settings_controls.description: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)

settings_controls.label: Subagent Live Preview
settings_controls.description: Show each pinned subagent's current (or most recent) tool call beneath its row

settings_controls.label: Smooth Streaming
settings_controls.description: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

settings_controls.label: Hide Tool Activity
settings_controls.description: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

settings_controls.label: Show Token Usage
settings_controls.description: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

settings_controls.label: Show Turn Time
settings_controls.description: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

settings_controls.label: Cache Miss Marker
settings_controls.description: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

settings_controls.label: Collapse Compacted History
settings_controls.description: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

settings_controls.label: Show Hardware Cursor
settings_controls.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support

settings_controls.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
settings_controls.description: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

settings_controls.label: Steering Mode
settings_controls.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

settings_controls.label: Follow-Up Mode
settings_controls.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

settings_controls.label: Interrupt Mode
settings_controls.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

settings_controls.label: Vim Mode Indicator
settings_controls.description: How the current Vim mode appears in the status line

settings_controls.label: Loop Mode
settings_controls.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

settings_controls.label: Loop Condition Timeout (ms)
settings_controls.description: Max wait for a `/loop --while` / `--until` condition command before treating it as broken and stopping the loop. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely

settings_controls.label: Bare Exit on Empty Session
settings_controls.description: Submitting exactly `exit`, `quit`, or `q` (any case) before the first message quits instead of prompting the model

settings_controls.label: Bare Slash Commands
settings_controls.description: Submitting exactly a command name without the leading `/` (e.g. `model`, `compact`) runs that slash command; once the session has messages, press Enter twice to confirm

settings_controls.label: Session Tree Filter
settings_controls.description: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

settings_controls.label: Autocomplete Items
settings_controls.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

settings_controls.label: Typo Detection (macOS)
settings_controls.description: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries

settings_controls.label: Word Autocomplete
settings_controls.description: No word completion

settings_controls.label: Autocorrect (macOS)
settings_controls.description: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words

settings_controls.label: Emoji Autocomplete
settings_controls.description: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`

settings_controls.label: Large Paste Menu
settings_controls.description: When a paste reaches this many lines, offer a menu to wrap it in a code block, wrap it in XML tags, or save it to a file. 0 disables the menu (large pastes still collapse to a [Paste] marker).

settings_controls.label: Quiet Startup
settings_controls.description: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages

settings_controls.label: Show Startup Splash
settings_controls.description: Show the full animated setup splash on normal interactive startup without rerunning setup. Quiet Startup still suppresses it.

settings_controls.label: Setup Wizard
settings_controls.description: Show newly added onboarding steps once per setup version

settings_controls.label: Check for Updates
settings_controls.description: Check for omp updates on startup

settings_controls.label: Update Channel
settings_controls.description: Update channel used by omp update and the startup update check

settings_controls.label: Marketplace Auto-Update
settings_controls.description: Check for plugin updates on startup

settings_controls.label: Startup Changelog
settings_controls.description: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden

settings_controls.label: Completion Notification
settings_controls.description: Notify when the agent finishes a turn

settings_controls.label: Error Notification
settings_controls.description: Notify when the agent stops with an error

settings_controls.label: Ask Timeout
settings_controls.description: Auto-select the recommended ask option after this many seconds (0 disables). Also bounds cfg:// approval prompts; an unanswered approval denies the write instead of auto-selecting

settings_controls.label: Ask Notification
settings_controls.description: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input

settings_controls.label: Idle Recap
settings_controls.description: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle

settings_controls.label: Idle Recap Delay
settings_controls.description: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap

settings_controls.label: Sleep Prevention
settings_controls.description: Prevent the system sleeping during active sessions. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

settings_controls.label: Enable Prewalk
settings_controls.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

settings_controls.label: Codex Code Mode
settings_controls.description: Route Codex code_mode_only models (GPT-5.6) through eval. The direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind. Use eval cells for other session tools. Mirrors codex-rs Code Mode. 'auto' follows the model catalog flag.

settings_controls.label: Codex Code Mode Direct Tools
settings_controls.description: Extra direct tools for Codex Code Mode. The standard direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind.

settings_controls.label: Describe Images for Text Models
settings_controls.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

settings_controls.label: Thinking Level
settings_controls.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models

settings_controls.label: Hide Thinking Blocks
settings_controls.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

settings_controls.label: Expand Thinking Blocks
settings_controls.description: Keep finished thinking blocks expanded instead of collapsing them when the turn ends

settings_controls.label: Prose Only Thinking
settings_controls.description: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis

settings_controls.label: Omit Thinking summaries
settings_controls.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

settings_controls.label: External Thinking
settings_controls.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning

settings_controls.label: Loop Guard
settings_controls.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

settings_controls.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
settings_controls.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

settings_controls.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
settings_controls.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

settings_controls.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
settings_controls.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

settings_controls.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
settings_controls.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

settings_controls.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
settings_controls.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

settings_controls.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
settings_controls.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

settings_controls.label: Include Model in Prompt
settings_controls.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

settings_controls.label: Include Workspace Tree
settings_controls.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

settings_controls.label: List Skills in Prompt
settings_controls.description: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful

settings_controls.label: Personality
settings_controls.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

settings_controls.label: Temperature
settings_controls.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Top P
settings_controls.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff (0-1, -1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Top K
settings_controls.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Min P
settings_controls.description: Minimum probability threshold (0-1, -1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Presence Penalty
settings_controls.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Repetition Penalty
settings_controls.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

settings_controls.label: Text Verbosity
settings_controls.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

settings_controls.label: Service Tier — OpenAI
settings_controls.description: Processing tier for OpenAI / OpenAI-Codex requests, and OpenAI-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as `service_tier`.

settings_controls.label: Service Tier — Google
settings_controls.description: Processing tier for Gemini (Google AI Studio + Vertex) requests, and Google-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as the top-level `serviceTier` field.

settings_controls.label: Service Tier — Subagent
settings_controls.description: Service Tier for spawned task/eval subagents. Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers (tracks /fast); pick a value to apply it to whichever family the subagent's model belongs to.

settings_controls.label: Service Tier — Advisor
settings_controls.description: Service Tier for the advisor model. None = standard processing; Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers; pick a value to apply it to the advisor model's family.

settings_controls.label: Retry Attempts
settings_controls.description: Maximum retry attempts on API errors

settings_controls.label: Max Retry Delay
settings_controls.description: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling — to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

settings_controls.label: Retry Model Fallback
settings_controls.description: Allow retry recovery to switch to configured fallback models

settings_controls.label: Fallback Trigger
settings_controls.description: Which failed requests may switch to a configured fallback model

settings_controls.label: Usage-Aware Fallback
settings_controls.description: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.

settings_controls.label: Reserve Margin
settings_controls.description: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.

settings_controls.label: Reserve Policy
settings_controls.description: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.

settings_controls.label: Fallback Revert Policy
settings_controls.description: When to return to the primary model after a fallback

settings_controls.label: Anthropic Server-Side Fallback (Fable 5)
settings_controls.description: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 5 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.

settings_controls.label: Ollama Cloud Max Concurrency
settings_controls.description: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit

settings_controls.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
settings_controls.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

settings_controls.label: Fireworks Tier
settings_controls.description: Default serving path (no service_tier)

settings_controls.label: Tiny Model Device
settings_controls.description: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

settings_controls.label: Tiny Model Precision
settings_controls.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

settings_controls.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
settings_controls.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

settings_controls.label: Unexpected Stops
settings_controls.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

settings_controls.label: Kimi API Format
settings_controls.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

settings_controls.label: OpenAI WebSockets
settings_controls.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

settings_controls.label: OpenAI Live Steering
settings_controls.description: Deliver messages typed while a GPT-6 response streams into that response over the Codex WebSocket, instead of waiting for the next tool boundary

settings_controls.label: Muse Code Stored Responses
settings_controls.description: Store Muse Code results on Meta's servers so a turn whose connection drops is recovered instead of re-run. Stored runs keep prompts and outputs on Meta's side.

settings_controls.label: Prompt Cache Retention
settings_controls.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

settings_controls.label: Cache Warming
settings_controls.description: Re-send the last request with a one-token output budget shortly before its prompt-cache entry expires

settings_controls.label: Stream First Event Timeout
settings_controls.description: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

settings_controls.label: Stream Idle Timeout
settings_controls.description: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

settings_controls.label: OpenRouter Routing
settings_controls.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

settings_controls.label: Fetch Provider
settings_controls.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

settings_controls.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
settings_controls.description: Spend saved Codex rate-limit resets automatically: restore an account blocked by an exhausted 5h or weekly window when a turn is stuck and no other account can take over, and salvage credits that are about to expire. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables both checks.

settings_controls.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Min Block
settings_controls.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.

settings_controls.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve
settings_controls.description: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically). Credits about to expire are exempt — a reserved credit that expires preserves nothing.

settings_controls.label: Codex Reset Salvage Horizon
settings_controls.description: With auto-redeem enabled, spend a saved Codex reset within this many hours of expiry when either chat window has meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; credits expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage.

settings_controls.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Resets
settings_controls.description: Spend eligible Claude Cedar or Juniper resets automatically. Cedar is spent only for covered limits; Juniper can only recover a sole 5-hour block. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables blocked recovery and expiry salvage.

settings_controls.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Min Block
settings_controls.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted covered windows — is at least this many minutes away. A 5-hour-only reset is never used for a weekly or model-scoped block.

settings_controls.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Reserve
settings_controls.description: Keep at least this many Claude resets banked (0 allows the last eligible reset to be spent automatically). The reserve applies to early salvage, but not to eligible resets expiring within 5 minutes.

settings_controls.label: Claude Reset Salvage Horizon
settings_controls.description: With auto-redeem enabled, use a server-selected Cedar reset within this many hours of expiry when its covered windows have meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; eligible Cedar or Juniper resets expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage or reserve. Provider limit requirements still apply.

settings_controls.label: Append-Only Context
settings_controls.description: Cache system prompt + tool specs and keep an append-only message log so provider prefix caches (DeepSeek, Xiaomi/SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate. Auto enables for known prefix-cache providers.

settings_controls.label: Enable Advisor
settings_controls.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
settings_controls.description: Pause main agent until advisor backlog falls below threshold. Numeric values cap wait at 30 seconds; strict waits for all scheduled reviews without a wall-clock cap. Off disables catch-up delays. Abort, failure, and disposal release waits.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Immune Turns
settings_controls.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns as non-interrupting asides for this many primary turns. Blockers are exempt from the cooldown.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Review Mode
settings_controls.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present. turn reviews every primary turn; agent-end reviews only final yields.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Review Interval
settings_controls.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present: review every Nth eligible primary update. 1 = every update. Skipped updates are sent with the next scheduled review.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Max Notes Per Update
settings_controls.description: Maximum non-blocker advice notes accepted per advisor prompt update (1–32; UI offers 1–5 quick picks). Blockers are exempt.

settings_controls.label: Advisor Evict Stale Results
settings_controls.description: Before each review, replace the advisor's read/grep/glob output from older reviews with a short placeholder. The latest review is kept.

settings_controls.label: Model Role Storage
settings_controls.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

settings_controls.label: Additional Workspace Dirs
settings_controls.description: Extra workspace directories added to every session as additional roots (multi-root workspace). Managed live via /add-dir and /remove-dir. Paths resolve relative to cwd; absolute paths recommended. The agent is told these roots exist and can read/grep/glob them.

settings_controls.label: Auto-Promote Context
settings_controls.description: Promote to a larger-context model on context overflow instead of compacting

settings_controls.label: Extended Context
settings_controls.description: Use larger context windows where supported; may incur premium pricing. Off keeps default or standard-pricing windows

settings_controls.label: Auto-Compact
settings_controls.description: Automatically compact context when it gets too large

settings_controls.label: Notes-backed context windows (experimental)
settings_controls.description: Keep persistent notes and searchable raw history across context windows.

settings_controls.label: Mid-Turn Compaction
settings_controls.description: Check thresholds at safe mid-turn tool-loop boundaries before the next provider request; subagents always check, since their whole assignment is one turn

settings_controls.label: Compaction Method Order
settings_controls.description: Preferred fallback order for automatic context maintenance; unavailable or failed methods advance to the next choice

settings_controls.label: Compaction Threshold
settings_controls.description: Percent threshold for context maintenance; set to Default to use legacy reserve-based behavior

settings_controls.label: Compaction Token Limit
settings_controls.description: Fixed token limit for context maintenance; overrides percentage if set

settings_controls.label: Save Handoff Docs
settings_controls.description: Save generated handoff documents to markdown files for the auto-handoff flow

settings_controls.label: Remote Compaction V2
settings_controls.description: Use Responses streaming compaction for compatible remote compaction models

settings_controls.label: Async Compaction
settings_controls.description: Speculatively summarize in the background as context nears the compaction threshold, then splice the ready result in when the threshold is crossed

settings_controls.label: Idle Compaction
settings_controls.description: Compact context while idle when token count exceeds threshold

settings_controls.label: Idle Compaction Threshold
settings_controls.description: Token count above which idle compaction triggers

settings_controls.label: Idle Compaction Delay
settings_controls.description: Seconds to wait while idle before compacting

settings_controls.label: Supersede Stale Reads
settings_controls.description: Prune older read results when the same file is read again (cache-aware, runs every turn)

settings_controls.label: Elide Uneventful Results
settings_controls.description: Prune tool results flagged contextually useless (no matches, timed-out waits) once consumed (cache-aware)

settings_controls.label: Snapcompact System Prompt
settings_controls.description: Experimental: render selected system prompt text as dense PNG image(s) and attach to the first user message (vision models only). Saves tokens; loses prompt caching for imaged text.

settings_controls.label: Snapcompact Tool Results
settings_controls.description: Experimental: render large historical tool results as dense PNG image(s) instead of text (vision models only). Saves tokens on accumulated read/search output.

settings_controls.label: Tool Calling Mode
settings_controls.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect.

settings_controls.label: Snapcompact Shape
settings_controls.description: Frame shape snapcompact prints text with (compaction archive and inline imaging). Auto picks a shape tuned for the current model.

settings_controls.label: Branch Summaries
settings_controls.description: Prompt to summarize when leaving a branch

settings_controls.label: Memory Backend
settings_controls.description: Off, local summary pipeline, Mnemopi SQLite, Hindsight remote memory, or Sharpshooter

settings_controls.label: Sharpshooter Model
settings_controls.description: Model selector for extraction/consolidation, empty = smol role

settings_controls.label: Auto-Learn (experimental)
settings_controls.description: After the agent stops, nudge it to capture lessons to memory and create/enhance isolated managed skills

settings_controls.label: Auto-run capture at stop
settings_controls.description: When on, auto-run one private capture turn at stop (uses extra tokens). When off, only standing auto-learn guidance remains.

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi DB Path
settings_controls.description: Optional SQLite DB path. Defaults to the agent memories directory.

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Bank
settings_controls.description: Optional shared bank base name. Per-project modes derive project-local banks from it.

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Scoping
settings_controls.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = project-local writes plus global recall visibility

settings_controls.label: Embedding variant
settings_controls.description: Local embedding model family. en = stronger English model; multilingual = cross-language model. Changing this rebuilds existing memory embeddings on next start.

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Auto Recall
settings_controls.description: Recall local memories into the first turn of each session

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Auto Retain
settings_controls.description: Retain completed conversation turns into local Mnemopi memory

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Polyphonic Recall
settings_controls.description: Fuse recall with graph, fact, vector and temporal voices so linked memories surface without a keyword match

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Enhanced Recall
settings_controls.description: Cache recall results for repeated and similar queries with identical options; any memory write clears it

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Proactive Linking
settings_controls.description: Ingest new memories into the episodic graph as they are stored, linking them to related entities and memories

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Disable Embeddings
settings_controls.description: Force deterministic FTS-only recall instead of vector embeddings

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Embedding Model
settings_controls.description: Advanced: explicit embedding model id that overrides the variant. Leave empty to use mnemopi.embeddingVariant.

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Embedding API URL
settings_controls.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint passed to Mnemopi

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi Embedding API Key
settings_controls.description: Optional embedding API key passed to Mnemopi

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi LLM Mode
settings_controls.description: Use no LLM, the online tiny model (the TINY role from /models, else @smol), or a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi LLM Base URL
settings_controls.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for Mnemopi remote mode

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi LLM API Key
settings_controls.description: Optional LLM API key for Mnemopi remote mode

settings_controls.label: Mnemopi LLM Model
settings_controls.description: Optional LLM model name for Mnemopi remote mode

settings_controls.label: Hindsight API URL
settings_controls.description: Hindsight server URL (Cloud or self-hosted)

settings_controls.label: Hindsight API Token
settings_controls.description: Bearer token for authenticated Hindsight servers

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Bank ID
settings_controls.description: Memory bank identifier (default: project name)

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Scoping
settings_controls.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = shared bank with project tags so global + project memories merge on recall

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Auto Recall
settings_controls.description: Recall memories on the first turn of each session

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Auto Retain
settings_controls.description: Retain transcript every N turns and at session boundaries

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Retain Mode
settings_controls.description: full-session = upsert one document per session, last-turn = chunked

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Mental Models
settings_controls.description: Read curated reflect summaries (mental models) into developer instructions at boot. Loads existing models on the bank — does not write. Pair with hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed to also auto-create the built-in seed set.

settings_controls.label: Hindsight Mental Model Auto-Seed
settings_controls.description: At session start, create any built-in mental models (project-conventions, project-decisions, user-preferences) that do not yet exist on the bank.

settings_controls.label: TTSR
settings_controls.description: Interrupt the agent mid-stream when output matches rule patterns (Time-Traveling Stream Rules)

settings_controls.label: Judged Rules
settings_controls.description: Ask the judge model role each `question` rule about completed replies, reasoning, and tool calls; a yes injects the rule as a warning

settings_controls.label: TTSR Context Mode
settings_controls.description: What to do with partial output when TTSR triggers

settings_controls.label: TTSR Interrupt Mode
settings_controls.description: When to interrupt mid-stream vs inject warning after completion

settings_controls.label: TTSR Repeat Mode
settings_controls.description: How rules can repeat: once per session or after a message gap

settings_controls.label: TTSR Repeat Gap
settings_controls.description: Messages before a rule can trigger again

settings_controls.label: Built-in Rules
settings_controls.description: Load the default rules shipped with the agent (override individually with ttsr.disabledRules)

settings_controls.label: Disabled Rules
settings_controls.description: Rule names to ignore entirely (applies to bundled defaults and your own rules)

settings_controls.label: Edit Mode
settings_controls.description: Select the edit tool variant (replace, patch, hashline, or apply_patch)

settings_controls.label: Fuzzy Match
settings_controls.description: Accept high-confidence fuzzy matches for whitespace differences

settings_controls.label: Fuzzy Match Threshold
settings_controls.description: Similarity threshold (0-1) for accepting fuzzy matches

settings_controls.label: Abort on Failed Preview
settings_controls.description: Abort streaming edit tool calls when patch preview fails

settings_controls.label: Recover Inline Edit Payloads
settings_controls.description: Execute edit payloads the model emits as plain text by converting them into edit tool calls

settings_controls.label: Block Auto-Generated Files
settings_controls.description: Prevent editing of files that appear to be auto-generated (protoc, sqlc, swagger, etc.)

settings_controls.label: Enforce Seen-Line Guard
settings_controls.description: Reject edits anchored on lines a prior read/search never displayed in full

settings_controls.label: Record Parse Regressions
settings_controls.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

settings_controls.label: Auto-Repair Parse Regressions
settings_controls.description: When an edit breaks a file's AST parse, ask the smol model to fix the broken region (validated by re-parse; falls back to a warning)

settings_controls.label: Artifact Spill Threshold (KB)
settings_controls.description: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline

settings_controls.label: Artifact Tail Size (KB)
settings_controls.description: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

settings_controls.label: Artifact Head Size (KB)
settings_controls.description: Amount of head content kept inline alongside the tail when output spills to artifact (middle elision). 0 disables — keep tail only.

settings_controls.label: Output Column Cap
settings_controls.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

settings_controls.label: Artifact Tail Lines
settings_controls.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

settings_controls.label: Artifact File Cap (MB)
settings_controls.description: Maximum size of the artifact file saved for streaming tool output (bash, python, js eval). Larger output keeps its beginning (up to 3 MB) and its most recent remainder, with a truncation notice between them. 0 = unlimited.

settings_controls.label: Line Numbers
settings_controls.description: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default

settings_controls.label: Default Read Limit
settings_controls.description: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit

settings_controls.label: Markdown Previews
settings_controls.description: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source

settings_controls.label: Read Summaries
settings_controls.description: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector

settings_controls.label: Prose Summaries
settings_controls.description: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads

settings_controls.label: Read Summary Body Lines
settings_controls.description: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it

settings_controls.label: Read Summary Comment Lines
settings_controls.description: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it

settings_controls.label: Read Summary Minimum File Length
settings_controls.description: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized

settings_controls.label: Read Summary Unfold Target
settings_controls.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

settings_controls.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling
settings_controls.description: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.

settings_controls.label: Inline Read Previews
settings_controls.description: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows

settings_controls.label: Tool Approval Policies
settings_controls.description: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.

settings_controls.label: Tool Approval
settings_controls.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

settings_controls.label: Todos
settings_controls.description: Enable the todo tool for task tracking

settings_controls.label: Todo Reminders
settings_controls.description: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping

settings_controls.label: Todo Reminder Limit
settings_controls.description: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up

settings_controls.label: Create Todos Automatically
settings_controls.description: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message

settings_controls.label: Todo Auto-Clear Delay
settings_controls.description: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget

settings_controls.label: Glob
settings_controls.description: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup

settings_controls.label: Grep
settings_controls.description: Enable the grep tool for regex content search

settings_controls.label: Grep Context Before
settings_controls.description: Lines of context before each grep match

settings_controls.label: Grep Context After
settings_controls.description: Lines of context after each grep match

settings_controls.label: AST Grep
settings_controls.description: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search

settings_controls.label: AST Edit
settings_controls.description: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites

settings_controls.label: Find (semantic grep)
settings_controls.description: Enable the find tool: natural-language search for files and line ranges, judged by the judge model role. Auto enables it only when the judge role resolves to a native TypeSafe jev model

settings_controls.label: Debug
settings_controls.description: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging

settings_controls.label: Services
settings_controls.description: Enable named bash services and proc:// supervision for shared long-running project processes

settings_controls.label: Speech Generation
settings_controls.description: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Kokoro) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis

settings_controls.label: Generate Image
settings_controls.description: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Exposed as an xd:// device when tools.xdev is on.

settings_controls.label: Computer
settings_controls.description: Enable the scriptable host-desktop eval prelude (screenshots, input, accessibility)

settings_controls.label: Ratchet
settings_controls.description: Enable the ratchet eval/hillclimb prelude; /ratchet turns it on for the current session

settings_controls.label: Archive
settings_controls.description: Enable the read-only archive eval prelude: prompt history, recent projects, past sessions and recaps

settings_controls.label: Computer Display
settings_controls.description: Active window's display (active), all displays (all), or a native display id

settings_controls.label: Computer Screenshot Width
settings_controls.description: Maximum screenshot width in pixels

settings_controls.label: Computer Screenshot Height
settings_controls.description: Maximum screenshot height in pixels

settings_controls.label: Image Question Timeout
settings_controls.description: Per-request timeout for the vision-model call behind read's ?q= image questions, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

settings_controls.label: Checkpoint/Rewind
settings_controls.description: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing

settings_controls.label: Read URLs
settings_controls.description: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs

settings_controls.label: Obsidian Vault
settings_controls.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

settings_controls.label: GitHub CLI
settings_controls.description: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)

settings_controls.label: GitHub View Cache
settings_controls.description: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free

settings_controls.label: GitHub Cache Soft TTL
settings_controls.description: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)

settings_controls.label: GitHub Cache Hard TTL
settings_controls.description: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)

settings_controls.label: Web Search
settings_controls.description: Enable the web_search tool for live web results

settings_controls.label: Security
settings_controls.description: Enable OMP-native security scan planning, execution, and the read-only security:// resource namespace

settings_controls.label: Ask
settings_controls.description: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions

settings_controls.label: Intent Tracing
settings_controls.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

settings_controls.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
settings_controls.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

settings_controls.label: Experimental Speculative Execution
settings_controls.description: Enable the discard-safe first slice: validated local reads through direct read calls and nested eval. Network requests, provider completions, and live filesystem writes are not part of this baseline.

settings_controls.label: Speculative Execution Concurrency
settings_controls.description: Maximum number of validated local reads allowed to run before normal dispatch.

settings_controls.label: Max Tool Timeout
settings_controls.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

settings_controls.label: Async Execution
settings_controls.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

settings_controls.label: xd:// Tools
settings_controls.description: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools under xd:// device URLs driven via read/write instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Sessions whose explicit tool list grants read but omits write mount devices through a device-only write transport (only local:// scratch stays writable besides devices). Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.

settings_controls.label: xd:// Prompt Docs
settings_controls.description: Choose which mounted-device docs and schemas are inlined in the system prompt. Built-ins keeps core tools inline while MCP and extension tools stay on-demand.

settings_controls.label: xd:// Inline Devices
settings_controls.description: When xd:// Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, inline dynamic devices whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.

settings_controls.label: Auto QA
settings_controls.description: Automated tool issue reporting (xd://report_issue). On by default; the first report asks for consent, and denying it disables reporting until re-enabled explicitly

settings_controls.label: Auto QA Push Endpoint
settings_controls.description: Full URL receiving Auto QA JSON reports (default https://qa.omp.sh/v1/grievances)

settings_controls.label: LSP
settings_controls.description: Enable the lsp tool for code intelligence (definitions, references, diagnostics, rename)

settings_controls.label: Lazy LSP Startup
settings_controls.description: Start language servers on first use (lsp tool or editing a matching file type) instead of at session startup

settings_controls.label: Shared Language Servers
settings_controls.description: Share one language server per project across omp instances via the daemon broker (falls back to private servers when unavailable)

settings_controls.label: Format on Write
settings_controls.description: Automatically format code files using LSP after writing

settings_controls.label: Diagnostics on Write
settings_controls.description: Return LSP diagnostics after writing code files

settings_controls.label: Diagnostics on Edit
settings_controls.description: Return LSP diagnostics after editing code files

settings_controls.label: Deduplicate Diagnostics
settings_controls.description: Suppress post-edit LSP diagnostics already shown for a file; only surface new or changed ones

settings_controls.label: Bash
settings_controls.description: Enable the bash tool for shell command execution

settings_controls.label: Allow Compound Commands
settings_controls.description: Evaluate literal && chains per command; unmatched commands use normal bash approval policy and mode

settings_controls.label: Bash Auto-Background
settings_controls.description: Automatically background long-running bash commands and deliver the result later

settings_controls.label: Git Guard
settings_controls.description: Refuse git commands that discard or move shared work in the bash tool: stash, reset --hard or to another commit, and checkout/switch/restore outside a merge or rebase conflict

settings_controls.label: Bash Approval Patterns
settings_controls.description: Ordered bash command approval rules. Each item has match and approval fields; only '*' wildcards are supported.

settings_controls.label: Bash Interceptor
settings_controls.description: Block shell commands that have dedicated tools

settings_controls.label: direnv Auto-Load
settings_controls.description: Auto-load a repo's direnv/devenv `.envrc` into the bash session so devenv tools and env vars are present without manual `direnv exec`. Honors direnv's allow list: an `.envrc` you haven't `direnv allow`ed is never executed

settings_controls.label: direnv Load Timeout (ms)
settings_controls.description: Max wait for the first `direnv export` (a cold devenv shell can be slow); on timeout the session runs without the direnv env

settings_controls.label: Shell Minimizer
settings_controls.description: Compress verbose shell output (git, npm, cargo, etc.) before returning it to the agent

settings_controls.label: Shell Minimizer Source Outline
settings_controls.description: Source outline mode for cat/read of source files: default or aggressive

settings_controls.label: Python Eval Backend
settings_controls.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Python cells to the IPython kernel

settings_controls.label: JavaScript Eval Backend
settings_controls.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch JavaScript cells to the in-process runtime

settings_controls.label: Eval Environment Provisioning
settings_controls.description: Automatically create the managed JavaScript eval package environment on first install

settings_controls.label: Eval-Defined Tools
settings_controls.description: Let eval cells define tools (@tool in Python, tool(fn) in JS) that task, agent(), and workpool() subagents can call

settings_controls.label: Fresh Workpool Agents
settings_controls.description: Spawn a new subagent for every workpool item instead of reusing workers or batching queued items

settings_controls.label: Eval Auto-Background
settings_controls.description: Automatically background long-running eval cells and deliver the result later

settings_controls.label: Python Kernel Mode
settings_controls.description: Keep the IPython kernel alive across eval calls or start fresh each time

settings_controls.label: Python Interpreter
settings_controls.description: Optional path to an exact Python executable. When set, automatic Python runtime discovery is skipped.

settings_controls.label: Isolate Subagents
settings_controls.description: Run subagents in an isolated copy of the checkout and integrate their changes afterwards

settings_controls.label: Isolation Backend
settings_controls.description: Backend used for subagent isolation and worktree cloning

settings_controls.label: Clone Checkout into Worktrees
settings_controls.description: New worktrees from `github pr_checkout` and `git worktree add` in bash start as a copy-on-write clone of the current checkout so ignored build artifacts (node_modules, target) carry over; falls back to a plain checkout when the filesystem cannot clone

settings_controls.label: Clean Source Checkout on /wt
settings_controls.description: When creating a worktree with `/wt`, reset tracked changes and remove untracked files from the original checkout after carrying them over

settings_controls.label: Worktree on Start
settings_controls.description: Whether fresh interactive sessions start in a new linked worktree

settings_controls.label: Worktree on Exit
settings_controls.description: What to do on exit with worktrees created since omp started (on start or with `/wt`)

settings_controls.label: Apply Isolated Changes
settings_controls.description: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts

settings_controls.label: Isolation Merge Strategy
settings_controls.description: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)

settings_controls.label: Isolation Commit Style
settings_controls.description: Commit message style for nested repo changes (generic or AI-generated)

settings_controls.label: Worktree Base Directory
settings_controls.description: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.

settings_controls.label: Prefer Task Delegation
settings_controls.description: How strongly to push delegating work to subagents

settings_controls.label: Batch Task Calls
settings_controls.description: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.

settings_controls.label: Speculative Task Launch
settings_controls.description: Start each batch subagent as soon as its tasks[] item finishes streaming instead of waiting for the whole task call. Launched agents are aborted if the finished call fails validation, is blocked, or its arguments change. Requires auto-allowed task approval and no extension tool lifecycle handlers.

settings_controls.label: Per-Task Effort
settings_controls.description: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

settings_controls.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
settings_controls.description: Maximum number of subagents running concurrently

settings_controls.label: LSP in Subagents
settings_controls.description: Allow subagents spawned via the task tool to use the lsp tool. Off by default to keep subagents cheap; enable when LSP-aware delegation is worth the extra tokens.

settings_controls.label: Max Task Recursion
settings_controls.description: How many levels deep subagents can spawn their own subagents

settings_controls.label: Max Subagent Runtime
settings_controls.description: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.

settings_controls.label: Subagent Completion Probe
settings_controls.description: Ask a working subagent, through a cached side request like /btw, to estimate how complete its task is: after 2, 5, 10 and 30 more minutes, then hourly. The estimate shows next to the subagent in wait and task views. Only subagents spawned by the main agent of an interactive session are asked; print, RPC, ACP and SDK runs never probe.

settings_controls.label: Agent Idle TTL
settings_controls.description: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.

settings_controls.label: Soft Subagent Request Budget
settings_controls.description: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must yield its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them.

settings_controls.label: Soft Request Budget Notice
settings_controls.description: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.

settings_controls.label: Maximum Per-Spawn Effort
settings_controls.description: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint. Lower values prevent callers from escalating subagents above this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.

settings_controls.label: Generic Task Prewalk
settings_controls.description: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.

settings_controls.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
settings_controls.description: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

settings_controls.label: Plan Mode
settings_controls.description: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution

settings_controls.label: Start in Plan Mode
settings_controls.description: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session

settings_controls.label: Autosave Plans
settings_controls.description: Automatically save approved plans to disk when plan mode completes

settings_controls.label: Autosave Directory
settings_controls.description: Directory for autosaved plans. Supports ~, absolute, and cwd-relative paths. Empty uses <project>/.omp/plans/.

settings_controls.label: Goal Mode
settings_controls.description: Enable per-session goal mode and the hidden goal tool

settings_controls.label: Goal Status in Footer
settings_controls.description: Show token budget alongside the goal indicator in the status line

settings_controls.label: Title Icons
settings_controls.description: Icon and short code that head new generated or /rename session titles

settings_controls.label: Title Generator
settings_controls.description: What names an untitled session from the user's messages

settings_controls.label: Refresh Title on Replan
settings_controls.description: Refresh generated session titles after todo init replans unless the title was set by the user

settings_controls.label: Skill Registry
settings_controls.description: Skillshare registry used by `omp skill` to install, search, and publish skills (https://host[:port])

settings_controls.label: Skill Commands
settings_controls.description: Register skills as /skill:name commands

settings_controls.label: Claude User Commands
settings_controls.description: Load commands from ~/.claude/commands/

settings_controls.label: Claude Project Commands
settings_controls.description: Load commands from .claude/commands/

settings_controls.label: OpenCode User Commands
settings_controls.description: Load commands from ~/.config/opencode/commands/

settings_controls.label: OpenCode Project Commands
settings_controls.description: Load commands from .opencode/commands/

settings_controls.label: Tool Call Handler Timeout (ms)
settings_controls.description: Positive finite active-work timeout for extension tool_call handlers; invalid values use 30000ms, and time awaiting OMP-owned dialogs does not count

settings_controls.label: Exa
settings_controls.description: Enable the Exa web search provider

settings_controls.label: Exa Search Delay
settings_controls.description: Minimum delay between Exa web search requests in milliseconds; set 0 to disable pacing

settings_controls.label: SearXNG Endpoint
settings_controls.description: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance used for web search

settings_controls.label: Browser
settings_controls.description: Enable the browser eval prelude for scripted Chromium automation (Puppeteer)

settings_controls.label: Browser CDP URL
settings_controls.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

settings_controls.label: Browser Relay
settings_controls.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser prelude needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

settings_controls.label: Browser Relay URL
settings_controls.description: omp browser relay endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9224).

settings_controls.label: Headless Browser
settings_controls.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

settings_controls.label: cmux Browser
settings_controls.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

settings_controls.label: Tern Browser
settings_controls.description: Inside a Tern pane, open browser tabs as picture-in-pictures over omp's pane (native web view) instead of headless Chromium; falls back to Chromium when no Tern window can host them. Explicit app options, the relay and Browser CDP URL take precedence; app.tern:false opts one open out. Set PI_BROWSER_TERN=0 or PI_BROWSER_TERN=1 to override.

settings_controls.label: Freeze Browser Tabs On Turn End
settings_controls.description: Freeze OMP-owned headless browser tabs when a turn settles so animated pages stop burning CPU/GPU while idle. Tabs unfreeze automatically on next use; pass persist:true on open to opt a tab out.

settings_controls.label: Browser Idle Close Timeout
settings_controls.description: Close OMP-owned headless browser tabs and Tern browser picture-in-pictures idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never; session dispose still reaps). Never touches relay/CDP/spawned browsers or other sessions' tabs.

settings_controls.label: Screenshot Directory
settings_controls.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

settings_controls.label: IDA Pro
settings_controls.description: Open executables read with `read` in IDA Pro (idalib) and enable the `ida` tool; inert when no IDA install is found

settings_controls.label: IDA Python
settings_controls.description: Python interpreter that can import ida_domain and idapro; empty auto-detects

settings_controls.label: IDA Install Dir
settings_controls.description: Directory containing libidalib, exported as IDADIR; empty auto-detects ($IDADIR, ida-config.json, standard install paths)

settings_controls.label: IDA Max Open Databases
settings_controls.description: Most IDA databases (omp.ida.* daemons in omp ps) open at once per project; opening another saves and closes the least recently used idle one

settings_controls.label: IDA Idle Close Timeout
settings_controls.description: Save and close IDA databases idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never); the exec namespace resets on reopen

settings_controls.label: MCP Project Config
settings_controls.description: Load .mcp.json/mcp.json from project root

settings_controls.label: MCP Startup Window
settings_controls.description: Wait this many milliseconds for initial MCP tool discovery; 0 waits until connections settle

settings_controls.label: MCP Markdown Results
settings_controls.description: Render non-JSON MCP text results as Markdown in the transcript

settings_controls.label: MCP Update Injection
settings_controls.description: Inject MCP resource updates into the agent conversation

settings_controls.label: MCP Notification Debounce
settings_controls.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for MCP resource updates before injecting them into the conversation

settings_controls.label: Serve Images as URLs
settings_controls.description: Publish outgoing images through the configured backend chain and send URL-fetching providers short URLs instead of inline base64. Falls back to inline automatically when every backend or a provider fetch fails

settings_controls.label: Image URL Backends
settings_controls.description: Ordered destinations tried when publishing images for provider access

settings_controls.label: Image Upload Command
settings_controls.description: Argv template for the command backend; {file} is the image path, {mime}/{ext} optional. The last URL printed on stdout is used (e.g. pasta -b -f {file})

settings_controls.label: Image URL Public Base
settings_controls.description: Externally reachable base URL fronting the blob server (required for ssh, optional for direct)

settings_controls.label: Image URL Lifetime (hours)
settings_controls.description: Serving window for locally hosted image URLs, measured from the last time a conversation sent them; resuming a conversation re-arms the window at the same link. 0 keeps links alive while the broker runs

settings_controls.label: Image URL Bind Host
settings_controls.description: Host the blob server binds to; loopback for tunnels, 0.0.0.0 for direct serving

settings_controls.label: Image URL SSH Target
settings_controls.description: user@host destination for the ssh reverse forward

settings_controls.label: Image URL SSH Remote Port
settings_controls.description: Remote listen port of the ssh reverse forward that your web server proxies to

settings_controls.label: Hide Secrets
settings_controls.description: Obfuscate configured secrets and redact credential-shaped tokens before sending to AI providers

settings_controls.label: Local TTS Voice
settings_controls.description: Kokoro voice used by the local TTS backend (American/British, female/male)

settings_controls.label: Local TTS Speed
settings_controls.description: Speaking rate of the local TTS backend (tts tool, omp say). 1 = normal; clamped to 0.5–2.5

settings_controls.label: Speech Vocalization
settings_controls.description: Speak the assistant's output aloud through the speakers as it streams

settings_controls.label: Speech Vocalization Mode
settings_controls.description: What to speak: all = assistant messages + thinking; assistant = messages only; yield = only the final message at turn end

settings_controls.label: Enhanced Speech Rewriting
settings_controls.description: Rewrite assistant output into natural spoken prose with the tiny/smol model before synthesis (describes code, drops links and markdown). Falls back to mechanical cleanup on failure

settings_controls.label: Speech Vocalization Voice
settings_controls.description: Kokoro voice used when speaking the assistant's output aloud

settings_controls.label: Speech Vocalization Speed
settings_controls.description: Speaking rate when reading the assistant's output aloud. 1 = normal; clamped to 0.5–2.5

settings_controls.label: Speech-to-Text
settings_controls.description: Enable speech-to-text input via microphone

settings_controls.label: Speech-to-Text Submit Trigger
settings_controls.description: Choose when speech dictation automatically submits: Never, Release (2+ words), Release with complete sentence, or When I Say Submit.

settings_controls.label: Live Voice
settings_controls.description: Voice used by Codex-backed realtime voice sessions

settings_controls.label: Relay URL
settings_controls.description: Relay used by /collab (wss://host[:port])

settings_controls.label: Web UI URL
settings_controls.description: Browser UI used by /collab links; empty derives from collab.relayUrl; explicit http:// is localhost-only

settings_controls.label: Display Name
settings_controls.description: Name shown to other collab participants (default: OS username)

settings_controls.label: Auto Start
settings_controls.description: Host every interactive session via collab.relayUrl as it starts and publish it to the local registry (omp collab list); rooms rotate on session switch

settings_controls.label: Share Server
settings_controls.description: Share viewer/upload base used by /share (encrypted blob upload + viewer; links are <base>/<id>#<key>)

settings_controls.label: Share Store
settings_controls.description: Where /share uploads the encrypted session blob

settings_controls.label: Share Secret Redaction
settings_controls.description: Run the secret obfuscator over /share snapshots before upload (uses the secrets.* config)

settings_controls.label: Stream Server
settings_controls.description: Live stream server used by `omp stream` (https://host[:port]); viewers watch at <base>/<your Stencil username>

settings_controls.label: Extra Redaction Patterns
settings_controls.description: Additional regular expressions redacted from every streamed row, on top of env/secrets.yml values and built-in credential shapes

settings_controls.label: OTLP Telemetry Export
settings_controls.description: Allow OMP to export traces, logs, and metrics using OTEL_* endpoints. Changes take effect on the next launch.
